description: A parent-of-repos workspace: the root is NOT a Git repository, and two real repositories sit inside it as sibling sub-directories. Exercises the Codebase Memory extension's project-root resolution, where ProjectService.gitRoot() falls back to runtime.cwd and the extension indexes the whole parent subtree as one project.

felan.note: Same commit the single-repo codebase-memory-queries fixture pins, so the two benchmarks are directly comparable.

felan-platform.note: origin/main tip at fixture build time. Chosen as the scope-inflating sibling: 4.4x felan's file count and no ProjectService / gitRoot / SHA-literal collisions with the query ground truth.

excluded: .git (harness-evals copies workspaces without Git metadata by default; the root being non-Git is what the fixture needs, and the sub-directories being non-Git does not change ProjectService.gitRoot()'s fallback, which runs at /workspace)
node_modules (installed by workspace.setup for felan/ only)
untracked and gitignored files (the fixture is a `git archive` export of each pinned commit)
benchmarkChanges: No file contents were modified. Each sub-directory is a verbatim `git archive` export of its pinned commit.
groundTruthNotes: ProjectService is defined only in felan/packages/ext-codebase-memory/src/services.ts:8 — felan-platform has no ProjectService.
ProjectService.gitRoot() is called only at felan/packages/ext-codebase-memory/src/services.ts:34 and :81; felan/apps/tui/src/memory/project.ts holds the unrelated local `gitRoot` distractor.
The SHA-256 literal 2fdd4d…3475 appears only in felan/packages/ext-codebase-memory/{src/installer.ts,test/package.test.ts}.

felan-platform adds `runtime: AgentRuntime` distractors (apps/agent/src/agent-core.ts:137 plus docs) but no new class whose constructor takes one, so the structural-cross-ref ground truth is unchanged.

SessionRunner DOES exist in felan-platform (apps/agent/src/sessions/session-runner.ts:224), so the multi-repo not-found case queries WorkspaceReconciler instead, which is absent from both repositories.
